vectors.hostile_condition: Control: exact native AP2 mandate, exact action, current status, and one unused challenge.

executable_test.title: joins native AP2 evidence to CAID/AEB, reserves before effect, and returns ADMIT

vectors.hostile_condition: A valid evaluation for action A is presented while the executor resolves action B.

executable_test.title: refuses approve-A/execute-B using the executor-owned action before provider invocation

vectors.hostile_condition: Three concurrent callers present the same registered challenge and evaluation.

executable_test.title: admits one concurrent attempt and refuses the rest

vectors.hostile_condition: The same native AP2 replay identity is presented under a second A2A task and challenge.

executable_test.title: refuses the same AP2 mandate replayed under another A2A task

vectors.hostile_condition: The native mandate is revoked, or authorization-server evidence is substituted for the required AP2 authorization role.

executable_test.title: refuses revoked evidence and AS-only evidence that does not satisfy the AP2 role

vectors.hostile_condition: The provider is invoked but its commitment outcome cannot be learned.

executable_test.title: returns INDETERMINATE and permanently prevents blind retry after provider timeout
